for c in range(5,11): grid[6][c]=1; grid[10][c]=1

for c in range(6): grid[8][c]=1
for c in range(6,10): grid[8][c]=4
# write transform algorithm fill internal gaps in row between same color endpoints
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        color=max(set(row), key=row.count)
        # identify non-background color segments, gap of background between occupied cells
        bg=color
        i=0
        while i<len(row):
            if row[i]!=bg:
                i+=1; continue
            j=i
            while j<len(row) and row[j]==bg: j+=1
            if i>0 and j<len(row) and row[i-1]==row[j] and row[i-1]!=bg:
                for k in range(i,j): out[r][k]=4
            i=j
    return out
'''
